en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a steep funicular railway ascending a hillside into a brick tunnel portal. In the foreground, an old funicular car with two men standing at the open front platform is visible, with the tracks rising sharply behind it. Above the tunnel there is a building with timber-framed details and a balustrade. At the top left margin, the caption reads "GRAZ. SCHLOSSBERGBAHN".
